name: Armor Bearer
overview: The role of an armor bearer in Scripture is exemplified as a position of trust and faithful support in battle. Judges 9:54 shows an armor bearer carrying out a difficult command to prevent disgrace, while 1 Samuel 14:6-7 reveals the close partnership between Jonathan and his armor bearer, who encourages and stands ready to act according to Jonathan’s heart. These verses highlight the armor bearer’s commitment to serve courageously alongside their leader, relying on the Lord’s power in the face of danger.
